"""Controlled full DCP transport: identical simulated residuals, two mean fields."""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

import numpy as np

from analysis.render import runtime_env
from measure_noise_opening_stages import read_crops
from study_noise_local_transport import compare
from study_noise_profile_decomposition import projected, same_profile_context
from study_noise_neighbourhoods import ROOT, sha256, git


def mean_field(a, b):
    a, b = np.asarray(a), np.asarray(b)
    if a.shape != (128, 128, 3) or b.shape != a.shape or not np.isfinite(a).all() or not np.isfinite(b).all():
        raise ValueError('Two finite128x128 RGB fields required')
    return ((a.astype(np.float64) + b) * .5).astype('<f4')


def run():
    started = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    stamp = started.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')
    folder = ROOT / 'docs/validation/raw'
    names = ('sonde-etapes-ouverture-bruit-v001-20261028T104746Z.json',
             'prediction-locale-transport-bruit-v001-20261028T110349Z.json',
             'decomposition-profil-bruit-v001-20261028T111021Z.json')
    paths = [folder / n for n in names]
    hashes = [sha256(p) for p in paths]
    pilot, prior, attribution = [json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) for p in paths]
    request_path = Path(prior['request']['path'])
    if sha256(request_path) != prior['request']['sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Frozen parent request changed')
    request = json.loads(request_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    old_native_path = Path(prior['native']['path'])
    if sha256(old_native_path) != prior['native']['sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Frozen native parent changed')
    old_native = {r['case_id']: r for r in json.loads(old_native_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['records']}
    tool = ROOT / 'build-patch_noise/burst-tools/Release/iprLocalNoiseTransport.exe'
    tool_hash = sha256(tool)
    subprocess.run([str(tool), '--self-test'], check=True, env=runtime_env(tool), timeout=30)
    work = ROOT / 'build-patch_noise/profile-mean-fields' / stamp
    work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    fields = work / 'means.f32'
    crops = {}
    for path, item in pilot['native'].items():
        pixels = Path(item['pixels']['path'])
        if sha256(pixels) != item['pixels']['sha256']:
            raise ValueError('Cached pixels changed')
        crops[path] = read_crops(pixels, item['record'])
    with fields.open('xb') as handle:
        for case in request['cases']:
            pair = pilot['records'][case['pair_index']]
            a, b = pair['paths']
            if not same_profile_context(pilot['native'][a]['record'], pilot['native'][b]['record']):
                raise ValueError('Inconsistent profile context')
            if sha256(Path(case['profile'])) != case['profile_sha256']:
                raise ValueError('Profile changed')
            roi = case['roi']
            field = mean_field(*[crops[p]['pre_dcp_camera_rgb'][roi][64:192,64:192] for p in (a,b)])
            case['mean_field_offset'] = handle.tell()
            handle.write(field.tobytes())
    request.update(mean_fields=str(fields), mean_fields_sha256=sha256(fields),
        policy='All18 fixed cases,32 same-seed RAW simulations. Store camera realizations in memory, subtract per-pixel ensemble mean, reuse identical residuals around uniform mean of real A/B midpoint and full real midpoint field. Full production DCP, no Jacobian or input clipping. Original simulation branch retained as exact replay control. Pair-assisted mean fields are an attribution oracle, not a mono-image predictor. No fitted parameters.')
    freeze = folder / f'gel-champs-moyens-profil-bruit-v001-{stamp}.json'
    with freeze.open('x', encoding='utf-8') as handle:
        json.dump(request, handle, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1, allow_nan=False)
    print('FROZEN', freeze, flush=True)
    out = work / 'native.json'
    subprocess.run([str(tool), str(freeze), str(out)], check=True, env=runtime_env(tool), timeout=1500)
    native = json.loads(out.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    observed = {r['case_id']: r for r in prior['records']}
    records = []
    for row in native['records']:
        old = old_native[row['case_id']]
        replay = max(float(np.max(abs(np.asarray(row[k])-old[k]))) for k in ('covariance_camera','covariance_working'))
        if replay > 1e-12:
            raise ValueError('Seeded simulation baseline changed')
        # Ensemble recentering must leave the temporal covariance invariant.
        centered_delta = float(np.max(abs(np.asarray(row['centered_input_covariance'])-row['covariance_camera'])))
        if centered_delta > 1e-10:
            raise ValueError('Recentering changed temporal covariance')
        target = observed[row['case_id']]['y_co_cg']['observed_covariance']
        comparisons = {name: compare(projected(row[key]), target) for name,key in (
            ('original', 'covariance_working'), ('uniform', 'controlled_uniform_covariance'),
            ('spatial', 'controlled_field_covariance'))}
        records.append(dict(case_id=row['case_id'], replay_covariance_delta=replay,
            centered_covariance_delta=centered_delta, comparisons=comparisons,
            spatial_vs_uniform=compare(projected(row['controlled_field_covariance']),projected(row['controlled_uniform_covariance'])),
            min_spatial_input=row['min_spatial_input'], min_uniform_input=row['min_uniform_input']))
    if len(records) != 18 or hashes != [sha256(p) for p in paths] or tool_hash != sha256(tool):
        raise ValueError('Incomplete coverage or changed provenance')
    summaries = {}
    for name in ('original','uniform','spatial'):
        ratios = np.array([r['comparisons'][name]['sigma_ratios'] for r in records])
        summaries[name] = dict(min_sigma_ratio=float(ratios.min()),max_sigma_ratio=float(ratios.max()),
            median_sigma_ratios=np.median(ratios,axis=0).tolist(),median_abs_sigma_error=float(np.median(abs(ratios-1))))
        print(name, summaries[name], flush=True)
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    output = folder / f'champs-moyens-profil-bruit-v001-{now.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")}.json'
    result = dict(campaign_id='noise-profile-mean-fields-'+stamp, schema_version=1,data_version=1,
        started_at_utc=started.isoformat(),completed_at_utc=now.isoformat(),measured_at_utc=now.isoformat(),
        parents=[dict(path=str(p),sha256=h) for p,h in zip(paths,hashes)],
        request=dict(path=str(freeze),sha256=sha256(freeze)),native=dict(path=str(out),sha256=sha256(out)),
        tool=dict(path=str(tool),sha256=tool_hash),records=records,summaries=summaries,
        commit=git('rev-parse','HEAD'),units='Normalized RGB covariance; dimensionless sigma ratios.',
        sources={n:dict(sha256=sha256(ROOT/n),source=(ROOT/n).read_text(encoding='utf-8')) for n in (
            'tests/study_noise_profile_mean_fields.py','tests/burst_tools/local_noise_transport.cpp')},
        limitations='Paired noisy midpoint is not latent clean signal or mono-image prediction. Recentered residuals preserve simulated temporal covariance but translation changes support and can produce negative camera values; no artificial input clipping, production DCP handles them. Gaussian iid RAW simulation omits real CFA correlations and some LibRaw post-RCD operations.32 finite trials; shared draws compare means without independently validating model. No production modification, new RAW decode, sealed final access or parameter fitting.',
        verdict='controlled_mean_field_attribution_not_production_validation')
    with output.open('x',encoding='utf-8') as handle:
        json.dump(result,handle,ensure_ascii=False,indent=1,allow_nan=False)
    print('RESULT',output,flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    run()
